integrity: A full analytic argument is supplied; the exact and symbolic checker tests finite instances and does not independently certify the infinite result or historical novelty.
mathematical_domain: Ewens Chinese restaurant growth with theta>0 and fixed k>=1; weak distributional limit of chronological no-small-cycle time fraction.
scientific_limitations: Functional convergence and stationary tandem queue representation are previously established, not claimed as new. Moment-product and sharp near-one upper-tail formulas require the additional argument given. No almost-sure convergence, finite-n tail estimate or moving-k limit is claimed.
title: Product moments and a sharp near-one tail for derangement-time fractions in Ewens growth
